buildLimits.quotaEvidence: Exact GetServiceQuota in us-west-2 succeeded; UsageMetric=null. Applied quota is not current headroom.
buildLimits.sharedRegionalQuotaHeadroom: Current running/queued use not measured; verify headroom before build approval
buildLimits.unsupportedFieldsPolicy: Trusted adapter must send only projectName plus persisted idempotencyToken; reject all other fields. IAM documented keys block supported overrides, but IAM cannot express a universal request-field allowlist. Independent watchdog/stop budget and reviewed exact build IDs required; these are operational safeguards, not a hard spend fence.

candidateStage.reason: CandidateID depends on the provider-observed namespace incarnation. Base writer/canary policies deny all actions.

cleanup.authority: Reviewed human bootstrap principal only for base resources; no broad runtime cleanup grant
cleanup.candidate: Store DeleteCandidate remains unsupported. Never delete an unknown, active or unproven candidate, or infer FinalNotCommitted from absence. Revoke/retire only verified owned Temporal keys and preserve failed/unknown outcome evidence first.
cleanup.kmsPendingDeletionCost: KMS key can remain billable until actual deletion; soft spend threshold is not guaranteed enforcement
sequence: stop only recorded owned build IDs and drain accepted outcomes
retain or explicitly resolve every candidate write/key outcome; no name-based deletion
confirm local control journal evidence safely retained outside ephemeral runtime namespace
remove owned images and ECR repository only after explicit identity/owner confirmation; force_delete=false prevents blind image purge
delete only exact owned IAM roles/boundaries and log group
disable/schedule owned KMS key deletion with seven-day recovery; TTL tags do not perform cleanup
for Temporal, remove only owned test namespace principals/namespaces and then empty owned project; each delete protection disable is a separate reviewed action

denialProofsOnOwnedSentinelsOnly: test role cannot StartBuild on a separate deny sentinel project; never probe production
CodeBuild service role cannot read a separately owned deny-sentinel secret or write deny-sentinel ECR
invoker cannot pass/assume any runtime role, change IAM, update project, or use supported build/source/role/image/environment/artifact/log overrides
candidate base roles deny all service operations
stage-two writer can only create/describe exact per-stage name with owned KMS and exact required owner/stage/namespace tags; wrong tag/KMS/name/replication denied
canary role reads only exact candidate; namespace/secret birth/version/journal checks remain mandatory
production-root negative cases are offline policy fixtures, not live probes

provisioning.accountGuard: provider allowed_account_ids plus exact SSO-role precondition
provisioning.passRole: No test identity receives iam:PassRole. Human provisioning may pass only the derived build execution role to codebuild.amazonaws.com in this reviewed action scope; existing SSO admin policy is not itself narrowed by this plan.
provisioning.productionRegion: us-west-1; fixture us-west-2 reduces regional contention but is not account isolation
provisioning.state: Separate local .state/fixture-20261030-01.tfstate; never infra/ backend; no secret values in state
provisioning.validationOnly: tofu init -backend=false and tofu validate; no plan/apply/import/destroy authorized

remainingGates: root review of exact rendered base and resource/permission matrix before any creation
verify regional CodeBuild quota and actual running/headroom before any build
record new KMS canonical ARN/provider birth and scoped role effective permission observations
confirm dedicated Temporal project creation entitlement/quota without enabling Projects or moving current resources
secure non-printing bootstrap delivery of namespace-scoped keys; OAuth/account-admin credentials never enter test workers
independent control and target Namespace CreatedTime/provenance before stage-two candidate IAM render
provider clarification/owned-sentinel proof for namespace ADMIN managing another scoped SA API key: docs currently establish only own-key versus global-admin-any-key
real durable candidate outcome ledger/guard/canary wiring before credential-staging end-to-end proof
managed runner digest/toolchain pin before general application build parity

resources.kmsKeyARN: Provider output, independently attest after creation; no guessed UUID or alias-as-provenance

storageLimits.buildArtifactEncryption: NO_ARTIFACTS sentinel; CodeBuild default artifact-key field is not the candidate CMK, and build role has no KMS permission
storageLimits.managedBuildImage: aws/codebuild/standard:7.0; no override, but mutable managed tag is not a cryptographic toolchain pin; full application-build lane remains pending
